input: Plan a sunrise hike for my partner's birthday

gold.taskTitle: Plan a Sunrise Hike for Partner's Birthday
gold.taskDescription: Organize a memorable sunrise hike experience to celebrate the user's partner's birthday.

questions.title: What date is your partner's birthday?
questions.description: Knowing the exact date helps determine sunrise time, weather expectations, and how much planning time is available.

questions.title: Which city or region will the hike take place in?
questions.description: Location determines which trails are accessible, the local sunrise time, and logistics like drive time.

questions.title: What is your partner's hiking fitness and experience level?
questions.description: This shapes the trail difficulty, distance, and elevation gain that are appropriate for the outing.

questions.title: Will it be just the two of you or a group?
questions.description: The number of people affects trail choice, carpooling, permit requirements, and any group logistics.

questions.title: Do you want to add a special element at the summit?
questions.description: For example, a packed breakfast, a gift reveal, or decorations — knowing this guides preparation and packing.

questions.title: Does your partner have any physical limitations or gear constraints?
questions.description: Injuries, mobility considerations, or lack of specific equipment may rule out certain trails or require rentals.

questions.title: Is this a surprise, or does your partner know about it?
questions.description: Whether it is a surprise determines how much coordination the user must do covertly and how to handle logistics like wake-up time.
